requirement.en: When your opponent Normal Summons a monster, or when an opponent's monster declares an attack.

effect.en: Place 1 Fairy Type Union monster or 1 "Protection of Arthenée" from your Graveyard on the bottom of the Deck. Then, you can change 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field to face-down Defense Position.
